issues.description: Many concrete operational recommendations (e.g., preference for repo links vs. uploaded archives, automatic submission receipts, recommended metadata fields, CI/test integration specifics) are presented as prescriptive steps but lack citations to the provided KB excerpts. Although many items are tagged as "general background knowledge", several are non‑trivial operational claims that should be either supported by KB excerpts or softened/qualified.
issues.required_fix: Either add KB citations (from the provided KB) to support each non‑trivial operational recommendation, or explicitly mark them as general background guidance and reduce prescriptive wording. For recommendations that map to content already present in other sections (team project artifact lists, milestone/rubrics guidance, Microsoft tooling), add explicit cross‑references and supporting footnotes to the matching KB excerpts (e.g., pages about 'Pokrok v matematice', Minecraft Education, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and the sections describing team project artifact requirements).

issues.description: Some practical steps are high‑level and would benefit from short concrete examples (e.g., example metadata field labels and sample rubric items mapping to CI test outputs).
